title: Encounter Geometry Effects on Space-Based Laser Debris Remediation and Estimation
summary: The escalating accumulation of orbital debris poses a critical threat to future space operations. Space-based lasers leveraging laser ablation have emerged as a promising approach for mitigating debris proliferation and preserving the orbital environment. Current literature, however, treats space-based laser debris remediation as a deterministic problem, assuming that momentum transfer and the resulting debris perturbations are precisely known. In reality, laser-to-debris engagement outcomes are inherently stochastic due to partially known debris characteristics. Compounding this challenge,…
